implementation_status.verified_mechanism: channels/0.1.json records the product-verified 13-repository + 7-corpus combination for release pipeline gating and audit provenance; clients do not download channels/0.1.json to select updates. Host plugins select compatible plugin Releases via harness-compatibility.json, and discover formal GitHub Releases across the 8 runtime/evaluation components directly from each official repository using monotonic max(installed, baseline, latest) selection without downgrades, dereferenced tag SHA + pyproject.toml + benchmark-results.json (release_gate) verification, side-by-side uv override runtime builds from exact Git SHAs, model-free API probes, and idle cutover while preserving native host payloads and without activating knowledge or capture (Codex/CC reuse a cancellable 300s check inside the MCP server process; Kimi runs a 300s launchd/schtasks job switching current.json; DSH runs a host-scoped idle timer mounting ./host3.mjs + remote-dev from the canonical adapter binding in config.json, with current.json only as a legacy seed fallback; Antigravity mounts plugins/mindie-agent with stdio MCP servers mindie-remote-dev and mindie-tools plus private knowledge_cli.py).
implementation_status.known_boundaries: The 0.1.5 channel pins verified releases across the 8 shared runtime/evaluation components (knowledge 0.13.7, remote-dev 0.11.2, profiler 0.5.3, sim 0.8.1, coordinator 0.7.0, npu-top 0.3.0, diagnostics 0.5.4, mindie-bench 0.4.5), 5 native host plugins (Codex 0.1.13, Claude Code 0.1.10, Kimi 0.1.10, DSH 0.1.9, Google Antigravity 0.1.0), and 7 public domain corpora. All five host plugins expose the remote NPU and deterministic component/diagnostic tools (diagnostics_status, diagnostics_bundle, coordinator, profiler, sim, npu_top) alongside session-gated knowledge retrieval and reuse shared user-private SSH authentication from remote-dev. Independent runtime component updates discover newer formal GitHub Releases directly from each official repository; already-loaded tool definitions in running host processes take effect on natural host reload or a fresh session. Installed-state automatic update acceptance is recorded in docs/releases/0.1.4/automatic-update-acceptance.json, cross-platform SSH authentication acceptance in docs/releases/0.1.2/ssh-auth-acceptance.json, and historical 0.1.0 benchmark re-evaluation under hardened behavioral oracles in docs/audits/2026-10-23-mindie-bench-integrity.md. See docs/release-compatibility-and-update.md for full update and reload boundaries.

patch_releases.summary: Initial 0.1.0 milestone baseline and Release Channel Manifest contract (channels/0.1.json). All 4 host plugins (v0.1.0) verify locked plugin-release auto-updates; direct runtime consumption of channels/0.1.json for in-place 0.1.x single-component hotfixes is the 0.1.x target architecture.

Shared SSH authentication in remote-dev 0.11.1 provides one-time password enrollment, public-key installation and recovery, cross-process/chat/plugin reuse, read-only monitor password fallback, and Git for Windows 2.56 SSH discovery. coordinator 0.7.0 and npu-top 0.3.0 reuse the same store. Codex 0.1.12, Claude Code 0.1.8, Kimi 0.1.7 and DSH 0.1.6 expose remote_auth and pin formal remote-dev 0.11.1; diagnostics aligns to existing formal 0.5.4. Nineteen real SSH tests across macOS, native PowerShell and actual WSL2 pass. Formal assets and source-bound benchmarks are verified; plugin initial baselines, isolated previous-formal updater acceptance and native catalog reload boundaries are recorded separately. The remaining component and seven corpus pins are preserved; historical value results are not relabeled.

profiler 0.5.1 (25c789cd42389c893234c5db20eca67e63b8878a) adds streaming native-library SHA256 digest checks, >=3s SQLite busy_timeout alignment, explicit TimeoutError propagation, and root CLI help/unknown-command diagnostics. Claude Code 0.1.9 (4f3450be4af65e0ee755d4d979695f3f6c5bca5e), Kimi 0.1.8 (c33006cc2a89ad0024396cdf838b1bfd6d6b7f35), and DSH 0.1.7 (223eedee381d06cbdbb096dc22e2d79dd5aa0cf2) complete native MCP registration across knowledge, remote, and components / mindie-tools (exposing diagnostics_status, diagnostics_bundle, coordinator, profiler, and sim with 660000ms outer tool timeouts) alongside Codex 0.1.12 and shared SSH authentication from remote-dev 0.11.1.

Knowledge 0.13.7 and four native plugin releases enable information-gap retrieval, shared explanation budgets, exact prerequisite revisions, and updates for managed Python module bindings. Installed-state acceptance exposed and fixed the legacy Kimi bootstrap-baseline regression and a DSH output-budget race. Codex adds verified native CLI 0.165.0-alpha.1.2 compatibility. mindie-bench 0.4.5 preserves missing knowledge observations and fixes native temporary-file placement. Historical simple-task cost signals and failed complex-task non-regression remain separately documented; automatic upgrades, one-time recovery of the damaged Kimi installation, and host reload evidence are recorded in docs/releases/0.1.4/automatic-update-acceptance.json.

Synchronizes formal component pins (remote-dev 0.11.2, profiler 0.5.3, sim 0.8.1) and completes the colloquial-prompt G0-G5 end-to-end benchmark across DSH (deepseek-flash, max) and Codex (gpt-6.1-sol, xhigh) covering 66 G0-G2 L2/L3 trials (100% pass rate on G2), G3 cross-task flywheel (0% -> 100%), G4 RSI exploration (0% -> 100%), and G5 5-episode evolution (A -> B -> C -> D -> E, 5/5 passed).
